description: Land Title Settlement Department - Koralawella, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520215
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (No. 144 and No. 156) with detailed property information including parcel numbers, extent, owner details, title class, and encumbrances. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
